10c7ae46:  ;
 ;Process DGPM entries:
 ; - determine admission date
 ; - determine ward location
 ; - determine division
 ; - determine bed occupancy status
 ; - process admission event based on status
 ;
664b8d5a: ;Extract admission date.
b505d0a5: ;Determine admission type/status.
4a1527f9: ;If admission type is incomplete with no details, log, delete.
e0e163ae: If this is the first incomplete record being processed and the quiet mode is not enabled, print a message indicating that incomplete records are being updated.
4b1dc4d2: If this is the first incomplete record being processed, set the DGONE flag to 0 to indicate that the initial record has been processed.
37371ed1: Call the DIK routine to delete any existing incomplete records.
3f772026: Call the WARD^DGJTUTL routine to determine the ward and division.
5803c285: If the X variable contains a valid ward number, set DGJTWARD to the ward number and DGJTDIV to the division name associated with that ward.
7f38ea2e: If the division has no treatment time defined or the treatment time is set to 0, skip processing this record.

c7987c58: If this is the first incomplete record being processed and the quiet mode is not enabled, print a message indicating that incomplete records are being updated. Set the DGONE flag to 0 to indicate that the initial record has been processed.
a3ee0e7c: If there is a pending transfer in the data, set DGJTSIFN to the internal entry number of the pending transfer.
1f018286: Call the DIS routine to process the admission record.

64d9cce9: Set the DIK variable to the global reference for the ADMISSION EVENT file (#393). Loop through all entries in the ADMISSION EVENT file (#393) that are associated with the current admission and delete them using the ^DIK routine. Clean up variables used by ^DIK.
d547cc0e: Kill variables used by the DIK subroutine.
6f3fd896: New line to kill DR variable used later.
abe5ac3b: Check if DGJTADM (admission IEN) is defined, if not go to DISQ to quit.
11ba6567: Check if there is an existing incomplete record for the admission.
d199a159: If an incomplete record exists, set DGJTDA to the record IEN.
a56de695: If DGPMT=3, an incomplete record exists, and DGPMA doesn't match DGPMP, update patient movement field.
d34d01a5: If DGPMT=1 (Admission) or 3 (Check-out), DGPMA exists, and no incomplete record, call NEW. If DGPMT=3 quit, else update record.
06b57fda: If DGPMT=1, DGPMP exists, DGPMA doesn't, and an incomplete record, delete the incomplete record.
28e7c93d: If DGPMT=1, an incomplete record exists, and DGPMA doesn't match DGPMP, call CK, then CHNG.
d89d9fec: Change admission if different and there is an existing admission.
6ff41b08: Create new admission if there is a PM# but no local admission and admission was incomplete.
dc0b68d2: Quit if admission was completed.
3950b482: Update existing admission if it was incomplete.
3bf5d4da: Change existing admission if different from sibling PM instance.
72ee6368: Change existing admission if different from parent PM instance.
7c9454be: Kill all temporary variables.
